scope: Homogeneous linear metric response at fixed physical x=r=2 and fixed incoming BD state. No coupled evolution, heating, stability or shifted-root/state calibration claim.
stress_definition: Density and pressure separately use direct full metric W0/W2/W4 subtraction reductions. Neither is defined by conservation or trace.
uncertainty_scope: Continuum precision comparisons and tanh-sinh estimates, finite-K SciPy memory estimates and float arithmetic are empirical diagnostics. Rational contacts and independent baseline primitives have floating-point arithmetic error. No finite-integral interval certification is claimed.
